WHY THIS HOTEL IS ONLY 3 STARS??? IMO, Santika Cirebon has everything to be rated at least 4 stars! Checking in was smooth and very sat set, considering I lost my id card in prev hotel. We stayed in deluxe suite room and the room was exceeding my expectation. It's equipped with a jacuzzi and everything was working properly. Well, maybe, except the room key. It was hard to open the door with that jadul key. Food was super delish! They have marshmallow and chocolate fountain. My kids were delighted! Swimming pool was big and clean. They also wash our car, for free 👌 I was touched by the kindness of the old gardener, I forgot his name, but he's old and clothed in green. Please raise his salary! I'm so gonna visit again in my next trip to Cirebon!

hotel bangunan tua tapi masi bagus fasilitas nya, pelayanan ramah, kebersihan lumayan

Stayed in a Superior room at Hotel Santika Cirebon it was a pleasant experience. Despite being a Superior type, the room was quite spacious and well-equipped with a mini fridge, kettle, and four bottles of mineral water. The air conditioning worked perfectly, ensuring a comfortable stay. However, I was slightly disappointed that my request for a large bed was not met; instead, two twin beds were combined into one. Another downside was that, although the floor looked clean, it turned out to be quite dirty when wiped with tissue. The bathroom was also spacious and came with adequate toiletries. Two large towels and two small towels were provided, and the hot water ran smoothly. Breakfast was varied and delicious, offering a good selection of dishes. The staff were very friendly and helpful, adding to the positive experience. A nice extra touch was that our vehicle was also washed. Overall, staying at this hotel was very enjoyable!

I stayed in a Superior Room at Hotel Santika Cirebon for the second time because this hotel is quite comfortable for an overnight stay. The bedroom and bathroom are spacious enough and well-equipped with adequate amenities. One great added value of this hotel is the complimentary vehicle cleaning, which is a nice touch. The sahur menu was quite complete and delicious. The staff was friendly, and the check-in and check-out process was fast and efficient. Overall, staying at this hotel was a very pleasant experience.

TAPI MENU SARAPANNYA ENAK SEMUA, wafflenya enak bgt, menu nasi dan lauknya enak semua, bubur manis nya enak semua. dengan harga segitu dgn experience yg didapat seperti itu, akan menjadi pilihan balik lagi kalo lagi di cirebon😁

On the bright side, I really liked the swimming pool, and the breakfast menu changed daily. The staff were also very friendly and helpful.

judul_ulasan: A Retreat in the middle of A Transit
teks_ulasan: A transit in a middle of a journey may give you a fast pacing time and annoying. But, lucky for me to stay in the hotel. Bed is comfy, room is quite spacious (not big, but enough space to move around), and the food is quite delicious for my tongue. The pool is great, with 180 cm depth in one side of the pool. The staffs are quite modest and you can feel their hospitality from the moment you were picked up from the train station. Overall, I enjoyed the night of my stay in the hotel. May come back soon.

Santika Cirebon, I think was an old hotel, so there's some sign of it on the building. But, the room is quite large, the bed is comfortable (I think the bed is firm or medium firm), the shower room is Good and clean. There's an electric kettle to make tea or coffee, along with all the amenities. Mini fridge, tv cable (unfortunately the image is not quite clear but good enough to read the news). They also have a different range of breakfast, although my mom said the taste is just so-so, but for me it's enough. You can choose from bread, cereal, rice porridge, fried rice, white rice and other Indonesian food. Overall it's quite enjoyable to stay in Hotel Santika.

judul_ulasan: Relaxing hotel and high quality service staff
teks_ulasan: Very pleasant stay : Nice bali style decoration , great swimming pool , good massage and the rooms were perfect. All these with very reasonable fares.

My first impression was that the hotel staff were very friendly and attentive. Breakfast was not as grand as Hotel Santika in Jakarta. The view of the room was so-so since it's located in the middle of the city. But we can see Mount Ceremai from afar.

We had a one night transit after a long drive from Semarang to Jakarta. We immediately felt at home when we arrived - a nice feeling. The room is nice, the view is great, the breakfast is nice too. The only problem is that our room was dusty - not too good for those allergic to dusts. The curtain smelt dust too. The fridge didn't work. You need to request for a hairdryer if you need one.

Actualy I book two rooms. My sister with her family stay in deluxe room. I stay at suite room. The price was fair but for suite room was rather expensive. The room was clean and cozy. The breakfast was ok and so many option/menu (traditional and international menu). Me and my kids love to the hotel pool. The water so warm and clean. At night we use becak (traditional public transportation) to travel around the city.

We stayed at Santika for one night after around 6 hours driving from Semarang.. Room was affordable and tidy. We love the breakfast menu variety offered from nasi jamblang, bubur ayam, to western food. My kids love the huge swimming pool and the outdoor kids playground.
had a pleasant stay at this hotel. will be checking in again the next time.

judul_ulasan: Decent hotel with an excellent service
teks_ulasan: The hotel is located pretty much in the cetral of Cirebon so, distance wise, it's easy to get around. However, the trick is to find yourselves a good and realiable means of transportation. Taxis sometime don't want to use the meter, so you have to bargain with the driver in advance - an annoying thing to do especially when you're traveling with a group requiring more than 1 car. The wisest thing to do in these circumstances is to ask for the hotel to arrange you the transportation. They have variety of cars (with drivers) that can be rented to take 6-8 passangers with a reasonable price. And if you're only aiming for a short trip to restaurant or anything considerably closeby, the hotel even gives you a shuttle service for free! I'd recommend that you give the tip / gratuity to the driver for this service (some of the drivers works at the concierge too). The room itself is decent, pretty clean, water runs with no problems. The swimming pool is nice and open til 9PM, so I did some night swimming which was nice. Breakfast is decent with selection of traditional, western and oriental food. The gym, however, needs a massive redo. Some of the equipment looks older than me:). Thank God for the swimming pool. If you really wanna keep burning calories during holiday, use the emergency stair case to get up to your room floor and down. The emergency stairs are well lit, mantained and located just next to the elevator. I stayed on 5th floor and use it all the time:)

What makes me upset about this hotel is the pick-up service they provided to us. The day before my arrival, I have checked via phone about my reservation. Thus, I just knew that they provided free pick-up and drop service to and from the train station. So, I ordered them to pick us up on our arrival date. Then, nobody showed up. This is the first time in my life that a hotel -already promised to pick us up- didn't show up. So, I called the hotel. They said they have sent a driver but nobody there. So, we decided to go to the hotel by ourselves with becak (traditional carriage). When I arrived at the lobby and checked-in, I complained about that problem. Instead of apologizing, the front office said she didn't quite know what's going on. She asked the bellboy that seemed the person who take care on this matter. This person also didn't apologize but giving me excuses which made me more angry. Later on, when he brought our luggage to our room, FINALLY he apologized. He tried to be nice by offering to bring us to one of the famous culinary place in Cirebon for free. The rest of our stay, he tried to be very nice and helpful. So, I don't think I'm upset with their service anymore but at least it left me with a bad note. If they can not deliver what they promised, it's better they don't promise it at all. The rest of our stay was good. The pool has warm water not because it is heated electrically but because Cirebon was very hot that the sun heated the water naturally. The breakfast food is delicious, always refill fast, and quite enough variants even though this hotel is only 3 stars. They have wi-fi in the room, sometimes it got slow, sometimes on and off. But it's okay. Room is spacious and clean. Staffs are great and nice in general.

judul_ulasan: Lovely hotel but it could be better
teks_ulasan: hotel santika is quite small, but it is beautifully landscaped. the swimming pool is big and one feels like it is a little piece of a tropical paradise. the restaurant offers a limited number of dishes, but they are very tasty and the prices are reasonable. breakfast is mostly indonesia food. as foreigners, we were not pleased with the limited options beyond the local fare, but the fruit selection was excellent. as most places in indonesia, the staff were lovely, friendly and warm. they were eager to help and to plealse and that made our stay enjoyable despite the fact that ciberon is a small town without many attractions. there are no nice restaurants or interesting places to visit. we are still trying to figure out how we got talked into going there! but we found that the town had amazing batik and that made our trip worthwhile. one major disadvantage of visiting a small town in indonesia is that almost no one understood/spoke english. although we had a small phrasebook, it was challenging to get around. however, in the hotel, all the staff spoke enough english to make the visit enjoyable. i would recommend this place only if you have to go to cirebon and only if you are looking for a few days to rest.

Both days we came down at 9 am and most everything was picked over by early risers and despite asking the manager, they failed to refill most things. Not acceptable. Location is good, easy to get to the major sites in town. Pool is large and sunny. Hotel bar is empty. Cirebon is a quiet town -

CirebonではHotel Santika Cirebonが好きです。 ホテルスタッフは皆フレンドリーで親しみやすく、 いつも暖かく迎えてくれます。 朝食のビュッフェも品数が多く、インドネシアの郷土料理も味わえます。 建物の老朽化が少々気になりますが、部屋は清潔に保たれています。 古き良きインドネシアのホテルという感じです。

judul_ulasan: 町中のリゾートホテルといった趣
teks_ulasan: チレボンの駅に着いてから送迎をお願いしたのですが、すぐに来てくれて助かりました。駅からは車で5分強といったところ。 ロビーやレストランには「チレボンと言えば」のメガムンドゥンモチーフが随所にあしらわれていて素敵です。 部屋はシンプル。お庭を囲むように建てられている客室棟、敷地内に木が多いせいか、蚊が多かったです。雨期だったせいかもしれませんが。 ドライヤーが部屋に標準装備されていませんでした。フロントに言えば持ってきてくれる、というパターンのようです。 敷地は広々していて、緑に囲まれたプールなどもあり、リゾートな雰囲気です。 朝食はご当地名物などもあり、まずまず充実していました。味も良かったですが、とびきりおいしい！というわけではなく。 また、ビールを含め、一切のアルコールを置いていません。バーもありません。法律によってコンビニや一定の規模以下のスーパーでもビールなど販売できなくなっていますので、近所で入手することもできません。

judul_ulasan: Hotel di Cirebon yang nyaman untuk Family
teks_ulasan: Secara keseluruhan ketika menginap di Hotel Santika Cirebon sangat menyenangkan terutama untuk anak saya, dia sangat menikmati sekali hotelnya. Mulai dari pertama kali datang (padahal posisi sudah malam sekitar jam 21.30 WIB) saya dibantu sekali bawaan barang oleh security didepan dan diarahkan untuk parkir mobil saya yang tidak begitu jauh dari lobby. Kemudian proses check in yang ramah dari staff Front Desk tetapi hanya saja untuk area lobby anak dan istri saya mendapati di gigit nyamuk ya mungkin karena area lobby nya termasuk semi outdoor, dan kemudian dibantu diarahkan ke kamar dan dibawakan barang oleh security tadi sampai kekamar (meskipun harus dibantu security tadi untuk buka access pintu kamar karena modelnya agak old style). Ketika masuk kekamar kondisi kamar untuk hotel lama termasuk masih terawat dengan baik terutama dari aroma kamar yang tidak sumpek atau apek, ya meskipun beberapa spot memang harus ada treatment, untuk view kebetulan saya mendapatkan pool view (NICE anak saya suka). Kemudian saya memesan room service, ya meskipun alternatif menu yang tersedia terbatas tetapi untuk kecepatan dan ketepatan menu yang dipesan baik dan untuk rasa masih acceptable dan lagi lagi anak saya suka. Dan ketika masuk ke area kamar mandi dan saya membuka pintu lemari saya mendapati ada 2 nyamuk yang terbang yang untungnya 2 nyamuk itu tidak sampai mengganggu kenyamanan. Untuk area kamar mandi cukup baik kondisinya, kondisi air panas tersedia dengan baik area mandi maupun wastafel, meskipun rain showernya tidak berfungsi hanya mengandalkan hand shower. Untuk kenyamanan tidur dan beristirahat cukup baik dan nyaman, entah karena kamar yang kedap atau memang kamar kamar lain tidak terisi tamu lain. Untuk keesokan harinya cukup menyenangkan juga tidak ada sesuatu hal yang mengganggu. Mulai dari sarapan yang enak meskipun varian tidak terlalu banyak dan lagi lagi anak saya sarapan cukup banyak. Kondisi kolam renang yang bersih rapi disertai dengan fasilitas ayun

koneksi internet (WiFi) lambat sekali

Kami agak kaget saat menginap di hotel Santika kali ini. Penampilan dari luar terlihat nyaman, namun saat memasuki kamar terlihat bahwa hotel ini sudah sangat tua dan butuh renovasi (kamar kami tipe superior twin bed). Headboard tempat tidur sangat kuno, begitu juga furniture lainnya seperti meja dan kursi. Kondisi kamar tidak terlalu bersih, banyak debu dimana2 khususnya di sudut2 kamar dan standing lamp. Saat kami check in, ada sejenis serangga yang berterbangan di kamar dan akhirnya diusir keluar oleh bell boy yang mengantarkan koper. AC kamar kami sangat berisik, seperti ada suara air mengalir. Kami minta teknisi untuk cek, dan menurut teknisi suara itu adalah suara air coolant dan tidak berbahaya. Teknisi akhirnya membersihkan ac di kamar kami dan ac outdoornya. Karena kami menginap di hotel ini hanya semalam maka kami tidak mempermasalahkan suara berisik ac tersebut ke management. Satu2nya yang kelihatan baru direnovasi adalah kamar mandi dalam kamar. Kelebihan hotel ini adalah lokasi yang memang strategis, serta ada petugas yang mencuci mobil kami. Breakfast juga baik dan variasi makanannya banyak.

Selepas lelah mengendarai mobil dari Banjarnegara selama libur Natal 2015, rencana kami berubah krn ada keponakan yg ikut serta. Berhubung kami late check-in dan minta tambah kamar tdk tersedia, kamar kami ternyata ditawarkan utk dinaikkan tingkat tanpa biaya. Kami minta 2 extra bed dan ruang kamar mencukupi. Senang sekali...

Kami kembali menginap di hotel ini untuk kedua kalinya. Awalnya abang becak yang mengantar kami ke hotel sempat ragu masuk ke pelataran, tetapi dengan sigap dan murah senyum satpam hotel mempersilahkan abang becak untuk segera masuk menurunkan penumpang di depan lobi, tidak lupa mengucapkan selamat datang kepada kami. Walau kami tahu sebenarnya ada fasilitas antar jemput hotel-stasiun/ terminal/ lokasi lain (khusus dalam kota Cirebon), tetapi kami memilih naik becak untuk lebih menikmati suasana kota Cirebon. Pada kunjungan kedua kami disuguhi minuman selamat datang berupa jus buah. Kamar mandi yang dulu sempat bermasalah tidak kami dapati kali ini. Pilihan menu makanan masih sedikit, harga sedikit mahal dengan status hotel bintang tiga, tetapi rasa masakan yang kami pesan tidak mengecewakan. Suasana kamar nyaman, fasilitas berenang gratis, fitnes gratis, antar jemput tamu ke penjuru kota Cirebon gratis, dengan atau tanpa tips kepada supir pelayanan kepada tamu tetap sangat ramah dan bersahabat. pelayanan in room dining juga tergolong cepat. Menu sarapan pagi bervariasi dan menu lokal selalu berbeda setiap harinya kecuali nasi jamblang pasti selalu tersedia setiap pagi. Variasi menu sarapan standar bintang tiga, rasa juga lumayan. Fasilitas antar ke stasiun ketika cek out kami gunakan dengan gratis, dengan tidak mengurangi keramahan staf dan supir hotel. Kalau mampir ke Cirebon kami merekomendasikan hotel ini untuk ditinggali.
hotel ini sangat terbuka dan ramah, hijau dan asri di dalam lingkungan hotel. memberikan suasana yang nyaman.
Pelayanan yang menyenangkan dari petugas hotel dan sangat informatif, ketika kami menanyakan tempat makan atau souvenir, petugas hotel menjelaskannya dengan map/peta yg digambar..

Staf melayani dengan ramah, kamar langsung tersedia tanpa harus menunggu, kondisi kamar bersih, kolam renang untuk anak-anak juga memadai. Breakfast disediakan makanan khas Cirebon. Lokasi dekat dengan wisata kuliner Empal Gentong Mang Dharma.

Harga makanan di restoran (room in service) terasa sangat mahal, kami harus membayar 36.000 IDR untuk 3 potong pisang goreng. Walaupun demikian, kami akan menginap kembali di Hotel Santika Cirebon bila berlibur disana

teks_ulasan: Suasana hotel asri, wilayah kolam renang tampak menyenangkan dan sangat mengundang, sayangnya saya tidak sempat menikmatinya. Kebersihan hotel sangat terjaga dengan baik. Ukuran kamar sangat mencukupi dan fasilitas juga memadai. Pelayanan sangat ramah. Lokasi sangat strategis untuk kebutuhan saya saat itu, yaitu menghadiri pernikahan sepupu yang diadakan di Islamic Centre yang hanya berjarak 5 menit naik mobil. Hotel ini juga dekat ke Grage Mall, yang bisa ditempuh hanya dengan jalan kali sekitar 10 menit. Sayangnya menurut saya dengan fasilitas yang ada, harganya agak terlalu tinggi. Satu hal lagi yang menurut saya agak kurang adalah pilihan sarapan yang agak terbatas. Namun, kedua hal tersebut mungkin tidak akan menghalangi saya untuk kembali memilih hotel ini sebagai tujuan saya pada perjalanan berikutnya.

judul_ulasan: Layanan Hotel cepat dan Bagus, Kamar Deluxe Luas
teks_ulasan: Saya menginap dua malam bersama Keluarga ( 2 anak), Lokasi Hotel tenang dan sangat strategis, anak anak cukup puas bermain di kolam renang Hotel dan Breakfast sangat memuaskan.
